title: Introduce SLO synthesizer and coldstart latency profiles for burst-resilient alerts
author: Ayesha Khan
release_notes: Adds a synth-based SLO generator that produces burst-resilient alert thresholds and a dashboard for coldstart latency profiling; non-breaking, opt-in via config flag.
description: Motivation: production SLOs were over-sensitive to short-lived token bursts and coldstart spikes from prefetch/backpressure. This PR implements a synthesis-based SLO engine that combines short-window burst-normalization, coldstart-aware percentile smoothing, and an exportable coldstart latency profile that teams can attach to alerting rules. Goals: 1) reduce noisy pager incidents caused by transient token surges 2) preserve sensitivity to real regressions 3) provide a compact dashboard and examples for teams to adopt. Design: the SLO synthesizer ingests per-route token-latency histograms and a short-term burst detector, computes a blended baseline from exponential-decayed percentiles and a coldstart correction curve, and emits threshold candidates with metadata (weight, expected false-positive rate, confidence). The coldstart profile is a small timeseries that summarizes latency decay in the first N seconds after container/model warmup, computed per model-version and region. Implementation: core synthesizer in obs/slo/synthesizer.go; a lightweight daemon obs/slo/collector that binds to the existing metrics pipeline and exposes a Prom-compatible endpoint; a dashboard JSON under observability/dashboards/coldstart-slo.json and an alerting recipe in observability/alerts/slo-synthesized-rules.yml. Opt-in: feature flag OBS_SLO_SYNTH=true toggles the new pipeline; default remains legacy SLOs until 2025-03-01. Backwards compatibility: synthesizer reads existing token-latency histogram buckets and uses same labels; emits new metrics prefixed with redwood_slo_synth_ to avoid collisions. Tests & validation: unit tests for the blending heuristic and coldstart curve generator (obs/slo/synthesizer_test.go), integration test that replays synthetic traffic and asserts stable alert counts, and a small loadbench verifying <1% CPU overhead at production sampling rates. Migration & rollout: staged rollout: feature-flagged canary (10% of routes) -> 50% -> 100% with a 24h monitor window and automatic rollback if alert volume increases >15% relative to baseline. Observability artifacts: the dashboard shows: coldstart decay panel (per-model-version), synthesized threshold ribbon overlay on per-route p95/p99 charts, and a regression explainer panel that links back to raw spans. Checklist: [x] core synthesizer implementation [x] collector + Prom export [x] unit + integration tests [x] dashboard + alert recipe [x] feature flag and rollout plan [x] runbook snippets for oncall. Related: ENG-3312 (SLO noisy-pager reduction), SRE-110 (coldstart mitigation). Documentation: docs/observability/slo-synthesizer.md with examples for teams and a short migration guide. Caveats: the blended heuristic uses a tunable alpha and requires representative histogram ingestion; teams with extremely sparse traffic may need to seed with synthetic warmups. Next steps: add quantized model-cost awareness to prefer lower-cost fallbacks for non-critical routes and extend the synthesizer to produce per-tenant suggested thresholds.

ci_checks: CI pipeline: unit-tests (pass), integration-replay (pass), linters (pass), security-scan (pass), helm-chart-check (pass). One transient flake on integration re-run that was rerun and passed.
notes_for_operators: To enable: set OBS_SLO_SYNTH=true in observability helm values or env. Watch new metrics: redwood_slo_synth_threshold{route,model,region} and redwood_slo_coldstart_profile_duration_seconds. If alert volume increases after enabling, rollback the feature flag and run 'make slo-synth-test' locally with the replay harness to reproduce. Runbook snippets are in observability/runbooks/slo-synth-runbook.md.
